name: Norman Skinner
source:
[i]"Will you allow me to analyze every facet of your existence?"[/i]

[i]Zealous Scientist[/i]

A Lab researcher. Pervert, after a fashion. Enjoys measuring and analyzing the abilities of all Sylphids and Academy students, but has no real interest in average data.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=norman]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
